documents.keep-isolation: Keep runs every agent tool call inside a Firecracker-style microVM. Each cell boots from a snapshot, has no host filesystem access and is destroyed after the session ends.
documents.approvals: Consequential actions pause for a human approval. The approver must be a different person from the proposer, and the approval is bound to a SHA-256 fingerprint of the exact action arguments.
documents.budget: Each workspace has a daily token budget. When inference would exceed the budget the API returns HTTP 429 and the request is not sent to the provider.
documents.audit-chain: Every audit event stores the digest of the previous event, forming a hash chain. Exporting the chain lets an auditor verify offline that no event was altered or removed.
documents.pii: Guardrails redact email addresses and long account-number-like sequences from prompts, documents and model output before anything is stored or shown.
documents.frankfurt-outage: Incident 2291: a power fault in the Frankfurt eu-central zone took three Pro-plan customer accounts offline for 47 minutes on 12 March.
documents.gpu-scheduling: Gryvia schedules GPU training and inference workloads on Kubernetes, packing jobs onto nodes by memory and interconnect topology.
documents.sso: Single sign-on uses OpenID Connect with the authorization code flow and PKCE. Identity provider groups map to Nuvora roles through a role map.
documents.postgres-ha: With a Postgres backend several Nuvora replicas share one database. Workers lease jobs with SELECT FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED so a job runs once.
documents.pricing: Production use requires a commercial license from Zyvor AI Labs. Evaluation, development and research use is free of charge.
documents.retention: Documents can be deleted individually; deleting a knowledge base removes all of its documents and their chunks from retrieval.
documents.streaming: Answers stream token by token. Text is held until a sentence boundary so the output guardrail can check it before release.
